analysis.r1_summary: R1 re-ran full analysis on pair0 (all values reproduced exactly: block_boundary 2.7761, gm_ratio 0.4012, PCA 4.432, sigma 0.74, NO_GLOBAL) and re-interpreted threshold/bias-prone signals. The only defensible correction hypothesis was blur_motion severity 4 -> 5: gm_ratio is measured on the final JPEG image whose block artifacts add gradient energy, so the severity estimate is a lower bound; pair2 gm_ratio 0.3619 lies only 0.012 above the sev5 cutoff 0.35; angle-agnostic spectral_slope matched sev5 in 2/2 R0 signal draws (sev4 borderline at 0.081-0.083 vs 0.08 threshold, sev3 0.129). Cross-support PSNR validation on all 3 pairs: R0 control motion:4+jpeg:3 = 22.29/32.30/23.56 (mean 26.05, CI 7-10/10); candidate motion:5+jpeg:3 = 30.97/19.56/25.05 (mean 25.19, CI 9-10/10), mean delta -0.86 dB, per-pair +8.68/-12.74/+1.49. No draw > 40 dB and no +2 dB mean gain -> NO_CHANGE. blur_motion draws angle U(-90,90) per apply, so the same pipeline spans 20.2-32.3 dB across draws; this variance exceeds the sev4/sev5 effect, so PSNR cannot arbitrate severity. JPEG=3 remains LIKELY (block_boundary 2.776/3.372/4.099, 0%FP detection; R0 bb-diff calibration 8-9% at sev3 vs 23-37% at sev1/2/4). No noise (sigma<2 on all pairs; peeled residual structured, spatial_corr 0.9735); no global step (mean_shift -0.4/-0.6/-0.7 of 255, contrast_spread 0.927-0.983, pair2 clipped_fraction 0.2034 is content/sky clipping).

cross_support_verification.result: CONSISTENT degradation family across 3 pairs (motion blur + JPEG, no noise, no global); severity 4 vs 5 not separable by PSNR under random motion angle
